Situated in Bela-Bela (Warmbaths), Limpopo, South Africa
Welcome to Thaba Monat Game Lodge situated in Bela-Bela (Warmbaths) in the province of Limpopo, South Africa, nestling in the heart of the Waterberg Mountains with excellent weather and year-round sunshine.
We are a Comfortable one and a half hour drive from Johannesburg brings you to this quiet and restful family resort, Thaba Monat offers fully equipped luxury self-catering chalets in private settings, or alternatively shaded and appealing caravan and camping sites.
This premier Bushveld Resort is renowned for its facilities in a magnificent and awe-inspiring reserve spreading over just over 400ha that is characterized by its unspoiled natural environment, wildlife and relaxed atmosphere under a star studded African sky.
As a well-established and efficiently managed resort, Thaba Monat will ensure you a memorable and relaxing holiday in the ultimate comfort coupled with unrivalled service. Be sure to make your booking well ahead of time!

The roads inside the resort are all gravel roads and are well maintained, although not all roads are accessible to normal vehicles, there are certain roads that are specified as 4 x 4 trails. Book at the Reception Office to take part in these outings, special arrangements can also be made for other times and days.
Thaba Monat boasts some of the best Birding opportunities in the area, so remember to bring your Cameras and Bird Books!
Confirmed animal sightings: Kudu, Impala, Blesbuck, Blue Wildebees, Red Hartebees, Waterbuck, Eland, Bushbuck, Giraffe, Klipspringer, Common Duiker, Warthog, Bushpig, Nyala, Brown Hyena, Leopard, Aardvark, Porcupine, Chacma Baboon, Vervet monkey as well as a host more smaller species

When it comes to check-in and check-out times, we kindly request your cooperation:
CHECK-IN: FROM 14H00 to 18h00 STRICTLY (The gate closes at 18h00 and no entry is permitted afterward)
CHECK-OUT: 10H00 (Later checkouts will be billed for a full day)
On Sundays, the main gate closes at 13H00
Our accommodations are designed to cater to different group sizes and preferences. Our 4-sleeper chalets feature a private room with a double bed and an upper loft room with 1 x bunk bed (consisting of 2 x single beds). The chalets also include their own braai area for outdoor cooking and relaxation. Please note that towels are not provided in the chalets. The maximum occupancy for the 4-sleeper chalets is 4 people, with 2 adults and 2 kids being the ideal configuration.
For larger groups, our 6-sleeper chalets offer two private rooms, each with a double bed, as well as a loft room with two separate single beds. The 6-sleeper chalets have their own braai area and do not provide towels. These chalets can accommodate a maximum of 6 people, with 4 adults and 2 kids being the recommended capacity.
If you prefer camping, Thaba Monat Game Lodge offers spacious camping sites. (Rooibok camp) Set in an open camp where antelopes freely roam through, these sites are within walking distance from our facilities and swimming pools. Each stand allows a maximum of 6 campers and includes an electric point. Shared ablution facilities are also available.
This weekend, treat yourself to a memorable getaway at Thaba Monate Game Lodge. Experience the beauty and tranquillity of Bela-Bela, while enjoying our comfortable accommodation and outstanding hospitality. Book your stay today and create unforgettable memories in this breathtaking destination.
